saloonprived.title: SaloonPrived
saloonprived.description: SaloonPrived is a video platform from the Bantubeat network, built to support and pay African content creators. Creators share their videos, grow an audience and withdraw their earnings through local payment methods such as mobile money. Accounts are shared with Bantubeat.
saloonprived.skills: <sk>Integrated many of the platform’s pages</sk><sk>Installed and configured urql as the GraphQL client</sk><sk>Built the homepage with a TikTok-style vertical video feed</sk><sk>Built the video streaming component with hls.js</sk>
saloonprived.summary: Content platform that lets African creators earn money from their videos.

featlink.title: Featlink
featlink.description: Featlink is a relational social network from the Bantubeat network. Members create a profile, discover other people and connect with them through an integrated chat.
featlink.skills: <sk>Integrated many of the application’s pages</sk><sk>Built the swipe component and its related actions with Framer Motion</sk>
featlink.summary: Social network of the Bantubeat ecosystem for meeting and chatting with people.

dobell.title: Dobell
dobell.description:
Dobell is a UK menswear brand founded in 2003 and specialized in formal wear: suits, tuxedos, morning suits, waistcoats and accessories. Its multistore Magento 2 webshop serves customers in the UK and internationally.

The project upgraded Magento from 2.4.4 to 2.4.7 and migrated the storefront from the default Magento theme to ScandiPWA, keeping every existing feature working while adding new agreed-upon ones. The most critical piece was payments: the new stores had to support methods the old ones lacked, namely Google Pay, Apple Pay, Klarna, Clearpay (UK only) and iDEAL (Netherlands only).
dobell.role: Full-stack developer on the Adyen payment integration, across the Magento back end and the ScandiPWA front end.
dobell.skills: <sk>Upgraded the Adyen PHP modules and adapted the existing Adyen customizations to keep them working</sk><sk>Configured the new payment methods in the Adyen account</sk><sk>Created GraphQL resolvers to serve payment data to the new ScandiPWA front end</sk><sk>Installed the Adyen JavaScript modules and wrote the GraphQL queries and mutations for each payment method</sk><sk>Customized the payment method interfaces to match the site’s design</sk>
dobell.summary: Magento 2.4.7 upgrade and ScandiPWA migration for a UK formal menswear brand, with new Adyen payment methods.

legeakademiet.title: Legeakademiet
legeakademiet.description: Legeakademiet is a Danish webshop selling learning and developmental toys to parents, grandparents and institutions, with brands such as BRIO, Magna-Tiles and Educa. It runs as a multistore e-commerce platform.
legeakademiet.skills: <sk>Integrated the authentication and customer account pages with HTML, Alpine.js and Tailwind CSS</sk><sk>Added Google, Facebook and Instagram login</sk><sk>Rebuilt the homepage to match the new design</sk>
legeakademiet.summary: Multistore e-commerce for a Danish retailer of educational toys.

hoitolatukku.title: Hoitolatukku
hoitolatukku.description: Suomen Hoitolatukku is the largest wholesaler for beauty and wellness professionals in Finland, with more than 5,500 products from over 75 brands. Its WordPress/WooCommerce store, with product data managed in Akeneo, lets registered salons order at trade prices with next-day delivery, and also offers training courses, a blog and a repair service.
hoitolatukku.role: Owned the Akeneo PIM and the WooCommerce store end to end, from discovery with the client to delivery.
hoitolatukku.skills: <sk>Delivered bundle products across the whole stack: ERP-to-Akeneo sync, a bundle editor in Akeneo, a custom WooCommerce REST controller, and bundle-aware product page, add-to-cart and stock sync</sk><sk>Built the events feature from discovery to launch, shaping requirements with the client</sk><sk>Rebuilt the product listing and product pages in Elementor, with FacetWP filters and sorting</sk><sk>Cleaned up the codebase and removed unused WordPress plugins without breaking the site</sk>
hoitolatukku.summary: WooCommerce B2B store, fed by Akeneo, for Finland’s largest beauty wholesaler.

juliussilvert.title: Julius Silvert
juliussilvert.description:
Julius Silvert is a food distributor founded in 1915 and based in Philadelphia. Its Magento B2B portal lets foodservice customers see their custom pricing, build order guides with requisition lists, reorder past orders and place orders before a daily cutoff for next-day delivery.

The project was a full migration from Adobe Commerce (Magento Enterprise Edition) to Magento Open Source, combined with a Magento version upgrade. Every existing feature had to be replicated: simpler ones were built from scratch, others were covered by third-party Magento 2 extensions that we installed, configured, customized and, where needed, migrated data into.
juliussilvert.skills: <sk>Migrated company account data from Adobe Commerce’s native B2B companies to Amasty Company Account</sk><sk>Installed, configured and customized Aheadworks Requisition Lists</sk><sk>Upgraded the Amasty Layered Navigation extensions and updated their custom code</sk>
juliussilvert.summary: Migration of a B2B Magento ordering portal from Adobe Commerce to Magento Open Source, for a Philadelphia food distributor.

seriesaddict.title: Series Addict
seriesaddict.description: Series Addict is a French-language website specialized in American TV series, with news, reviews and editorial guides for fans.
seriesaddict.role: Front-end developer, turning designs into production pages connected to the back-end API.
seriesaddict.skills: <sk>Turned Figma mockups into pixel-perfect, accessible and responsive pages</sk><sk>Integrated pages with the back-end API, using client-side or server-side rendering depending on each page’s needs</sk><sk>Implemented pagination display and navigation for long listings of series, news articles and more</sk><sk>Ran smoke QA tests and reported issues on GitHub</sk>
seriesaddict.summary: French website dedicated to American TV series.

panhomestores.title: Pan Home
panhomestores.summary: Optimized a large Magento 2 e-commerce store serving customers across the UAE.

bantubeat.title: Bantubeat
bantubeat.skills: <sk>Integrated pages from Figma designs</sk><sk>Built the multi-step, highly dynamic music form, handling data collection and submission with a visual loader</sk><sk>Created TypeScript interfaces for the API data models</sk>
bantubeat.summary: Led the front-end of a music platform built with Next.js, TypeScript and GraphQL.

open-source-guru.title: Open Source Guru
open-source-guru.description: Open Source Guru helps developers find their next open-source contribution. After signing in with GitHub, users follow up to 50 repositories and the labels they care about (such as “good first issue” or “help wanted”), then receive instant, hourly or daily email alerts. It also tracks contributions with streaks and goals, offers a public profile with a README badge, and exposes a REST API for managing subscriptions.
open-source-guru.role: Solo project: I designed, built and deployed everything, from the database schema to the production server.
open-source-guru.skills: <sk>Designed the PostgreSQL database schema and built the REST API with Fastify</sk><sk>Built the background worker (pg-boss) that checks followed repositories and sends instant, hourly or daily email alerts</sk><sk>Implemented sign-in with GitHub through a GitHub App and Better Auth</sk><sk>Created the app’s visual identity</sk><sk>Built the Next.js front end</sk><sk>Built the documentation site with Fumadocs, including the OpenAPI reference for the public API</sk><sk>Wrote unit and integration tests with Vitest, running against a real PostgreSQL database through Testcontainers</sk><sk>Set up a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions: linting, Conventional Commits checks and tests, Docker images built and pushed to GitHub Container Registry, then deployment to a VPS over SSH that syncs the Docker Compose file, pulls the images and rebuilds the containers</sk><sk>Configured the NGINX server, bought the domain name and set up its DNS</sk>
open-source-guru.summary: Free, open-source service that emails developers when good first issues appear in repos they follow.

retrouve-moi.title: Retrouve-moi
retrouve-moi.description: Retrouve-moi is a free citizen platform for reporting and searching for missing people, lost objects and lost documents across the ten regions of Cameroon. Anyone can submit a report without an account; reports are browsable by region and on an interactive map, alongside case statistics and emergency numbers.
retrouve-moi.role: Solo project: I designed, built and deployed everything, from the database schema to the production server.
retrouve-moi.skills: <sk>Designed the MySQL database schema and built the REST API with Laravel, using Sanctum token authentication and Redis for cache, queues and sessions</sk><sk>Created the app’s visual identity</sk><sk>Built the Next.js front end, including an interactive Leaflet map of reports with marker clustering</sk><sk>Built the reporting flow, open to visitors without an account, with forms validated by react-hook-form and zod</sk><sk>Wrote PHPUnit tests for the API, plus Vitest unit tests and Playwright end-to-end tests for the front end, with MSW to mock the API</sk><sk>Set up CI with GitHub Actions: front-end tests and build on every push, and Docker images for the front end and the API built and pushed to GitHub Container Registry</sk><sk>Deployed the stack on a VPS with Docker Compose (Next.js, NGINX with PHP-FPM, scheduler, Redis and MySQL) behind an NGINX reverse proxy that handles TLS, and set up the domain name and its DNS</sk>
retrouve-moi.summary: Citizen platform for reporting missing people and lost items in Cameroon.

booki.title: Booki
booki.description:
The company wants to develop a website that allows users to find accommodation and activities in the city of their choice.
You are responsible for integrating the site interface with HTML and CSS code. To do this, you work in close collaboration with Sarah, the CTO, and Loïc, the UI designer.
booki.skills: <sk>Implement responsive interfaces</sk><sk>Integrate content according to a design</sk>
booki.summary: Responsive accommodation and activities booking page integrated from a mockup.

ohmyfood.title: Ohmyfood
ohmyfood.description: Your mission is to develop a “mobile first” site that lists the menus of gourmet restaurants. In addition to traditional reservation systems, customers will be able to compose the menu for their meal so that the dishes are ready upon their arrival. No more waiting times at the restaurant!
ohmyfood.skills: <sk>Implement advanced CSS graphic effects</sk><sk>Set up a navigation structure for a website</sk><sk>Ensure the graphic consistency of a website</sk><sk>Use a version control system for project tracking and hosting</sk><sk>Set up your Front-End environment</sk>
ohmyfood.summary: Mobile-first restaurant menu site with advanced CSS animations.

panthere.title: Panthere
panthere.description: You work for the La Panthère agency, a large web design agency based in Lyon. The company's activity got off to a good start but today it is losing momentum. Yes, the competition is tough. The founder of the company, Sophie, is looking for a solution to restart the activity. By typing “Web design company Lyon” on the Internet, she notices that the agency’s website only appears on the second page of search engines. Luckily, one of your colleagues, Martin, told him that you were an SEO specialist.
panthere.skills: <sk>Conduct a keyword research for a website</sk><sk>Write maintainable HTML and CSS code</sk><sk>Optimize the size and speed of a website</sk><sk>Ensure the accessibility of a website</sk><sk>Optimize the SEO of a website</sk>
panthere.summary: SEO and accessibility audit and optimization of a web design agency’s website.

kanap.title: Kanap
kanap.description:
You have been working in a web development agency for a few weeks now. After having successfully completed the integration of a few websites (HTML/CSS), you are entrusted with a new mission.
Your client is Kanap, a sofa brand which sells its products exclusively from its store. Today, it would like to have an e-commerce platform in addition to its physical store to sell its products on the Internet.
kanap.skills: <sk>Create a test plan for an application</sk><sk>Validate data from external sources</sk><sk>Interact with a web service with JavaScript</sk><sk>Manage JavaScript events</sk>
kanap.summary: Dynamic e-commerce front-end in vanilla JavaScript, connected to a product API.

piiquante.title: Piiquante
piiquante.description:
You've spent the last year as an independent back-end developer, working on several projects of varying sizes and difficulties.
Last week, you received a message on your freelance platform asking for help with a new project. Hot sauces are becoming more and more popular, thanks in large part to the YouTube series "Hot Ones." This is why this new client, the chili-based condiment brand Piiquante, wants to develop a web application for reviewing hot sauces called "Hot Takes".
piiquante.skills: <sk>Implement CRUD operations in a secure manner</sk><sk>Implement a logical data model in accordance with regulations</sk><sk>Store data securely</sk>
piiquante.summary: Secure REST API for a hot-sauce review app, built with Node.js, Express and MongoDB.

kasa.title: Kasa
kasa.description: The Kasa site was coded more than 10 years ago in ASP.NET with significant legacy code. Laura, the CTO, therefore launched a total overhaul to move to a complete JavaScript stack with NodeJS on the back-end, and React on the front-end. Kasa also took the opportunity to order new models from his usual designer, who is freelance. A big project for this year!
kasa.skills: <sk>Initialize an application with Create React App</sk><sk>Configure navigation between the application's pages with React Router</sk><sk>Develop elements of a website interface using React components</sk>
kasa.summary: Rebuilt a rental platform front-end as a React single-page app with React Router.
